label: City
title: See the work behind the answer
detail: Follow one release-notes tool from request to checked output.
lines: When an agent writes a release tool, how do you know it works?
Agent City lets you follow the job and inspect the evidence.

label: Dispatch
title: Give the job a clear brief
detail: Example mission · Turn a list of changes into Markdown release notes.
lines: In Mission Command, ask for a tool that turns a list of changes into release notes.
Choose a workflow with a separate reviewer.

label: Library
title: See what the agent looked up
detail: Open the evidence for the source retrieval.
lines: In the Library, you can see when the agent retrieves reference material.
Open the linked evidence to see where it came from.

label: MCP Center
title: Trace the tool calls
detail: Follow the call to its source evidence.
lines: At the M C P Center, you can follow the calls the agent makes to enabled tools.
In this run, it read language documentation.

label: Workshop
title: Inspect the draft
detail: A separate reviewer leaves feedback on the tool.
lines: The Workshop shows the agent at work on the draft.
Open the mission to read the generated tool and the separate review.

label: Dojo
title: See what actually passed
detail: Recorded results · Valid syntax, exit code zero, exact output match.
lines: In the Dojo, you can see which checks ran.
This tool passed its syntax check, ran in an isolated workspace, and printed the expected output.

label: Archive
title: Revisit the evidence
detail: Open the saved mission to inspect the output, review, and checks.
lines: Open the saved mission to compare the tool, the review, and the check results.
You can replay recorded activity without running the agent again.
